intro: The probe was declared lost in 1994. Last night, it phoned home, and it had clearly been practising. In the back room of Flight, where the shift keeps its coffee and its spare logbooks, every incoming strip is now pinned to the corkboard beside the one before it, each sheet edged in a different colour of tape, none of them ever thrown away, each one kept just in case it turns out to matter. The senior capcom says the machine never sends anything it didn't mean to keep, and the younger controllers have started doing the same with their coffee cups, stacking them handle-out on the shelf above the printers, right up to the ceiling.
echo: For a few minutes, the day forgot to happen.

puzzles.title: Telemetry
puzzles.flavor: The host was particular about the seating, and more particular still about what each chair was worth.

clues: Exactly one person sits between Abigail and Florence.
Theodore sits somewhere between Abigail and Charles.
Ophelia sits somewhere to the left of Emilia.
Rosalind sits somewhere between Ophelia and Theodore.
Abigail and Theodore are not neighbours.
Florence and Rosalind are not neighbours.
Exactly 3 people sit between Charles and Florence.
